verdict.rationale: Muse is itself the built-in AI assistant/agent, delegating tasks like building tools, tracking goals, monitoring, and following up autonomously (muse-docs-1, muse-docs-7, muse-docs-16, muse-docs-20, muse-docs-24), with hands-on community testimony confirming agentic task delegation works (muse-docs-18, muse-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent rigorous benchmarking of delegation quality across diverse task types beyond anecdotal reviews and stress-test edge cases noted in muse-comm-1.
